title: On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots
abstract: We survey the ethical and environmental risks of large language models.

title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
abstract: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words
abstract: We show that pure transformers applied directly to image patches can perform very well on image classification tasks.

title: Training language models to follow instructions
abstract: We show that fine-tuning with human feedback greatly improves the usefulness of language models.
